_comment: Copy for the cards. Edit, then run: python scripts/render_cards.py (or just push: the workflow re-renders). Live numbers come from data/profile.json; {total} in an info value becomes the contribution count. status is [state, label] with state one of live (pulsing dot), done, queued (hollow dot).

projects.name: MedApp
projects.pitch: Practice software for Romanian clinics contracted with CNAS, built to replace the slow desktop apps from the 2005–2012 era. Offline-first on the clinic network: every CNAS call is queued and archived.
